name: Opening-range breakout (first 5/15/30 min), one trade — trending tape only (acr 1–5 min)
why: The opening range is where overnight and open-auction orders settle; a break of it means one side's resting orders are exhausted and stops beyond the range add fuel. Tape filter pre-registered 2026-10-17 (research/preregistered/2026-10-17_tape_filter_all.md).
